title: Writing Practice — Hand tools in technology classes — Compare two views
description: Academic Task 1 data report and Task 2 essay. Compare two views. Suggested time: 60 minutes.

tasks.prompt:
The table shows practical lessons using hand tools rather than powered equipment in three years: 2012, 2018 and 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Some people think students should learn hand skills before using machines, while others believe digital equipment can help students learn design more efficiently.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
